 Family Owned Seafood Restaurant in Gulf Shores Since 1987
Open daily 11 AM to 10 PM
Our MenuOrder TakeoutOrder DeliveryFor over 35 years, Mikee’s Seafood has been a Gulf Shores staple, serving up fresh, Southern-style seafood with a warm, family-friendly atmosphere. Proudly family-owned and operated since 1987, Mikee’s is more than just a restaurant—it’s a local tradition.
Whether you’re craving all-you-can-eat snow crab, a golden-fried seafood platter, or a refreshing Bushwacker from the bar, Mikee’s is the spot where locals and visitors come together to eat, laugh, and make memories. See our full seafood menu featuring Gulf Shores favorites. Our menu is packed with crowd favorites, from perfectly fried shrimp to grilled catch-of-the-day, all seasoned with that unmistakable Gulf Coast flavor.
Stop by and see why generations of locals and visitors call Mikee’s their go-to seafood spot.
Fresh seafood.
Southern hospitality.
Since 1987.
Why Locals Love Mikee’s
At Mikee’s, we’re more than just another seafood restaurant in Gulf Shores—we’re part of the tradition. From family recipes passed down through generations to daily specials that highlight the freshest catches, every plate is made with care. Guests love us for:

All-You-Can-Eat Specials – including snow crab and shrimp
Mikee’s Favorites – like Blackened Redfish topped with creamy shrimp and crab sauce
Family-Friendly Dining – kids’ menu, plenty of options for picky eaters, and options for the whole crew
Classic Southern Sides – cheese grits, red beans & rice, hush puppies, and more

Located right in the heart of Gulf Shores, Mikee’s is a must-visit for anyone searching  for good seafood in Gulf Shores. Come see why families return year after year and why locals have made us part of their weekly routine. Whether it’s lunch with friends, or dinner with family, we’re here to make your Gulf Shores seafood experience unforgettable.
